verdict.rationale: The registry publishes a few downloadable PDF forms, including a mass registered-agent change form, a prepaid account application, and an apostille request form. That is only a glancing sign of a paper rail. Nothing shows these forms are a fallback for the core online filings, and no mailing address or fax number is given. Missing for 10: published mailing addresses, fax numbers, paper versions of core filings (formation, periodic report), explicit guidance on filing offline when the online flow is unavailable.

support.subject: As a founder, a paper, fax, or mail fallback rail is published with the exact addresses, numbers, and forms, so the task can still be completed when the online flow is unavailable
